ambient_events: The floor-number display ticks smoothly upward and resettles.
A note of piped strings, so quiet it might be imagined, threads the car.
description: The car is a jewel-box of mirror-bronze and hand-rubbed walnut, a bench of oxblood leather along the back wall and a single orchid on a shelf that is replaced before it can ever wilt. A brushed panel of lit buttons glows beside the door, and a small screen overhead reads SOLENNE and the car's drifting position. Step out to return to the Grand Lobby.
name: Solenne Residences — Elevator
